lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Eleven senators. Four firms. One holding company whose registered address is a post box in the hills above a shipping city.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: None of it was hidden. Every interest was declared, correctly, every year, by people who believed that declaring it was the whole of the obligation. It simply had never been read in one place before.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The reading is suspended. It will stay suspended for eleven years, and in the eleventh year it will pass anyway, with everybody watching, which is a different kind of loss.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Continuity Holdings. Printed, filed, and sitting in a public record that still exists in my century, where I will be able to find it in two hundred and forty-eight years.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Somewhere downstream, something that has not been surprised in two hundred and eighty years makes a note.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It does not make the note quietly. There are three of them on the floor before the gallery has finished clearing, and not one of them is here about the treaty.
